The knight moves in an L-shaped pattern, covering two squares in one direction and one square in another direction. A diagonal move is not possible for the knight as it contradicts the movement rules of this piece.

Which of the following statements best describes the core idea of Grimm's Law?

Grimm's Law describes how certain consonant sounds systematically changed as Proto-Indo-European evolved into Germanic languages. This law highlights specific shifts, such as the transformation of voiced stops to voiceless fricatives.
